cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mo cua so lap trinh VBE; Insert > Module de viet code (khong viet tren Sheet de tranh mat khi xoa sheet).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Alt+F11 > Insert > Module

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Sub SayHello() ... End Sub; ten viet lien; F5 hoac nut tam giac de chay
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Moi chuong trinh la 1 Sub. If va End If, For va Next, Sub va End Sub phai di cap.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub SayHello()
 MsgBox "Hello"
End Sub  > F5

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien hop thong bao. Vi du kinh dien dau tien.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T1()
 MsgBox "Hello World"
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cells(hang,cot): hang 1 cot 1 = A1. Gan chu/so truc tiep.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T2()
 Cells(1,1) = "Hello"
End Sub 'A1=Hello

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Test tung lenh khong can Sub: go lenh + Enter chay ngay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Immediate go: Cells(2,3)="Ga Excel" > Enter (C2 nhan chu)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Theo TEN (ngoac kep) hoac SO THU TU tu trai. Dung truoc khi tac dong sheet dich.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T3()
 Sheets("Sheet1").Select
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Thuoc tinh .Name dat ten sheet thu 3.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T4()
 Sheets(3).Name = "Ga Excel"
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: ActiveWorkbook: file dang lam; Workbooks("Book1"): file chi dinh; ActiveSheet/ActiveCell: sheet/o dang chon. Lenh khong ro workbook tac dong file active.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T5()
 MsgBox ActiveWorkbook.Name
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cu phap Workbook.Sheet.Cells de ghi sang file khac dang mo.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T6()
 Workbooks("Book1").Sheets(2).Cells(2,1) = "Xin chao"
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Dim y As Integer (-32768..32767); Dim n As Long (+-2 ty); Single/Double; String; Object; Variant
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Integer nho, Long lon; String chuoi; Object doi tuong; Variant moi kieu (ton bo nho).
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T7()
 Dim y As Integer
 y = 5
 Cells(1,1) = y
End Sub 'A1=5

cong_thuc.cu_phap: y = 5 : Cells(1,1) = y  (doi y=7 chay lai o doi theo)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bien mang gia tri gan vao o; doi bien chay lai de thay dong.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T8()
 Dim y As Long
 y = 7
 Cells(1,1) = y
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Range nhan ca vung lien tuc hoac 1 o theo dia chi chu.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T9()
 Range("A1:B3") = "Ga Excel"
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: .Select chon vung; .Clear hoac = "" (ngoac kep rong) xoa nhanh.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub T10()
 Range("A1:A5").Clear
End Sub

cong_thuc.ten: For Each quet sheet + If xoa
cong_thuc.cu_phap: For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Sheets ... Next  +  If ws.Name <> ActiveSheet.Name Then ws.Delete
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Duyet tung Worksheet; khac ten sheet active thi xoa. Can Dim ws As Worksheet.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub XoaSheet()
 Dim ws As Worksheet
 Application.DisplayAlerts = False
 For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Sheets
  If ws.Name <> ActiveSheet.Name Then ws.Delete
 Next
 Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tat hop 'co chac muon xoa'; NHO bat lai True keo lan sau xoa nham khong hoi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: (xem code tren)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lap so lan co dinh; dung in 1 doan (thi sinh 10..20) thay vi While het danh sach.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub InDoan()
 Dim i As Long
 For i = 10 To 20 Step 1
  Sheet2.Cells(i,1) = i
 Next
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Do While ... Loop  |  Do Until ... Loop
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Lap khi con dieu kien; dung in HET danh sach khong biet truoc so luong.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub QDuyet()
 Dim i As Long: i = 2
 Do While Cells(i,1) <> ""
  i = i + 1
 Loop
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: In sheet bang code. Khong may in thi chon may PDF ao de test.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub InSL()
 Sheet2.PrintOut Preview:=False
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Dim fso As Object: Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tao doi tuong thao tac file. Object phai co Set (khac bien thuong). Dau _ cuoi dong de noi code.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub F1()
 Dim fso As Object
 Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
 MsgBox fso.FolderExists("D:\Data")
End Sub

cong_thuc.ten: Kiem tra thu muc + Exit Sub
cong_thuc.cu_phap: If fso.FolderExists(duongdan) = False Then MsgBox "Khong ton tai" : Exit Sub : End If
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chan truoc khi copy: thu muc nguon/dich phai ton tai.
cong_thuc.vi_du: (long vao Sub copy file)

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Copy file giua 2 thu muc; kieuFile loc loai.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub CopyF()
 Dim fso As Object
 Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
 fso.CopyFile "D:\Nguon\*.xlsx", "D:\Dich\"
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Tools > References > tick Outlook 16.0  +  Set olApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bat reference truoc moi goi Outlook tu Excel.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub M1()
 Dim olApp As Object
 Set olApp = CreateObject("Outlook.Application")
End Sub

cong_thuc.giai_thich: To lay tu cot email; HTMLBody chua <b> de in dam; Attachments.Add dinh kem; Send gui.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Sub M2() Dim m As Object Set m = CreateObject("Outlook.Application").CreateItem(0) m.To = Cells(2,2): m.Subject = "Hi": m.HTMLBody = "Ten": m.Send End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: olMail.BodyFormat = olFormatHTML  +  Substitute(body,cu,moi)  +  CountA dem nguoi nhan
cong_thuc.giai_thich: HTML cho ten bo dam; SUBSTITUTE thay ten/ma tung nguoi; CountA(B2:B100) dem so mail; For i=2 To SoNguoi quet email/ten/ma/file.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub GuiLoai()
 Dim n As Long, i As Long
 n = WorksheetFunction.CountA(Sheets(1).Range("B2:B100"))
 For i = 2 To n + 1
  Cells(i,2).Value
 Next
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Dau _ cuoi dong noi code  +  Insert > Module  +  luu .xlsm  +  Button Assign Macro
cong_thuc.giai_thich: _ giup code dai de doc; viet trong Module theo file; luu .xlsm giu macro; gan Button de bam chay.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub Demo()
 Dim x As Long: x = 1 + _
  2
 MsgBox x
End Sub 'x=3

cong_thuc.cu_phap: y = InputBox("Nhap mot so")  +  If y Mod 2 = 0 Then MsgBox y & " la so chan" Else MsgBox y & " la so le" End If
cong_thuc.giai_thich: InputBox hien hop nhap, gan bien y; Mod lay du; If...Then...Else...End If bat buoc di cap.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub ChanLe()
 Dim y As Long
 y = InputBox("Nhap mot so")
 If y Mod 2 = 0 Then
  MsgBox y & " la so chan"
 Else
  MsgBox y & " la so le"
 End If
End Sub

cong_thuc.cu_phap: For i = 2 To SoNguoi ... Next + If ... Then ... End If (quet dong 2..CountA, If kiem tra tung dong)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mau chung in phieu/xoa sheet/gui mail: For quet, If loc tung dong.
cong_thuc.vi_du:
Sub Q()
 Dim i As Long
 For i = 2 To 10
  If Cells(i,2) <> "" Then MsgBox Cells(i,2)
 Next
End Sub

steps.thao_tac: Buoc 1 (Mo VBE + Sub dau tien): Bat Developer > Alt+F11 > View > Immediate (Ctrl+G) > Insert > Module > Viet Sub SayHello + MsgBox > F5; doi sang Cells(1,1)=...; test ?1+1 trong Immediate
Buoc 2 (Cell-Range-Sheet-Workbook-Dim): Cells(hang,cot), Range("A1:B3"), Sheets(ten/so), Workbooks(...).Sheets(...).Cells(...) > Dim Integer/Long/String/Variant/Object; y=5: Cells(1,1)=y
Buoc 3 (In phieu + xoa sheet): While/For quet thi sinh + PrintOut Preview:=False > gan nut 'In danh sach' > For Each ws + If Name<>Active thi Delete + DisplayAlerts False/True > gan nut
Buoc 4 (Copy file FSO): Lay duong dan nguon/dich + kieu (*.*) > FSO CopyFile + FolderExists + MsgBox/Exit Sub > gan nut
Buoc 5 (Gui mail hang loat): References tick Outlook > CreateObject Outlook + For i=2 To CountA + Substitute + HTMLBody + Attachments.Add + Send > nut 'Gui email' > Luu .xlsm truoc khi giao file
